title: Tokenized Key-Gated Adapter Routing: A Secure Access Control Mechanism Against Private Data Leakage in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.00309v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in privacy-critical domains (e.g., healthcare, finance, and government), but their propensity to memorize and disclose personally identifiable information (PII) poses serious security and compliance risks. Existing defenses typically force a trade-off between model utility, privacy protection, and access to fine-tuned private knowledge. We propose LoRA-Oriented Control via Keyed Entry Tokens (Locket), a practical framework that embeds fine-grained, policy-driven access control directly into LLM generation. Locket trains a set of lightweight LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adapters, each encoding a distinct access policy (e.g., full reveal, partial redaction via PII masking, or reveal under a specified differential privacy level). translated_title: 基于令牌化密钥门控适配器路由的大语言模型私有数据泄露安全访问控制机制
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在隐私敏感领域（如医疗、金融和政府部门）的部署日益广泛，但其记忆并泄露个人身份信息（PII）的倾向带来了严重的安全与合规风险。现有防御方法通常迫使模型在实用性、隐私保护以及对微调私有知识的访问之间进行艰难权衡。我们提出了LoRA-Oriented Control via Keyed Entry Tokens（Locket），这是一个实用的框架，将细粒度、策略驱动的访问控制直接嵌入到大语言模型的生成过程中。Locket训练了一组轻量级的LoRA（低秩适应）适配器，每个适配器编码一种不同的访问策略（例如完全披露、通过PII掩码进行部分遮蔽、或在指定的差分隐私级别下披露）。通过序列级硬路由，训练一个紧凑的门控模块将学习到的密钥入口令牌与恰好一个LoRA适配器相关联；有效令牌的出现……
tldr: 提出Locket框架，通过将密钥入口令牌与编码不同隐私策略（完全披露、PII掩码遮蔽或差分隐私披露）的LoRA适配器绑定，在大语言模型生成过程中实现细粒度的策略驱动访问控制，有效防范私人数据泄露。
en_tdlr: Locket embeds fine-grained, policy-driven access control directly into LLM generation by binding keyed entry tokens to lightweight LoRA adapters encoding distinct privacy policies (full reveal, PII masking, or differential privacy), providing a practical defense against private data leakage.
